_comment: Single source of truth for daemon::tick::skeptic_evidence's coder/reviewer vendor canonicalization (bead rev-9zrgs). Keys are the canonical skeptic-reviewer vendor bucket names used by config/skeptic_reviewer_priority.json; each value lists the raw DARK_FACTORY_CODER_DEFAULT / DARK_FACTORY_REVIEWER_DEFAULT tokens that resolve to it. Matching is EXACT (trim + lowercase) against the WHOLE env var value, never substring .contains() -- this is what eliminates the 'claudem contains claude' ordering hazard the old code's inline comment flagged as a live risk. Investigation for rev-9zrgs: every real call site (daemon/tests/tick_integration.rs, daemon/systemd/drop-in/README.md, runner/__main__.py --ao-agent) sets this env var to a single bare token, never a compound/hyphenated/path-like string, so whole-string exact match is sufficient -- no token-splitting needed.
